# Calling Matrix

> 24/7 AI receptionist and answering service purpose-built for home service businesses. Answers every call in under 2 seconds, routes emergencies to on-call technicians, and books jobs directly into field-service software. Fully managed — we build it, train it, and manage it for you.

## What Calling Matrix does

Calling Matrix is an AI phone receptionist and answering service for trade businesses — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning, landscaping, pest control, garage door, appliance repair, and locksmith companies. It answers inbound calls 24/7, qualifies leads, routes emergencies to on-call technicians, and books jobs directly into scheduling software with no manual entry.

Every deployment is custom-built for that specific business: trained on their services, pricing, service territory, emergency protocols, and existing software stack. Ongoing support is included on every plan — businesses can request changes to services, voice, or features at any time.

## Who it's for

Home service businesses that lose revenue to missed calls: technicians who can't answer while on a job, owners who don't have front-desk staff, businesses that need after-hours coverage without hiring, and companies that handle surge volume (storm season for HVAC and roofing, spring for landscaping). Works for solo operators and multi-truck shops alike.

## Pricing

- **After Hours**: $297/month ($267/mo billed annually) — activates only during owner-defined off-hours (e.g. 6 PM–8 AM), books appointments and captures leads overnight
- **Starter**: $497/month ($447/mo billed annually) — up to 300 calls/month, 24/7 answering and booking, Google Calendar sync
- **Growth**: $797/month ($717/mo billed annually) — up to 800 calls/month, Housecall Pro/ServiceTitan/Jobber sync, emergency routing, monthly tuning by a human specialist, English + Spanish
- **Scale**: Custom pricing — unlimited volume, multi-location, enterprise CRM integrations, 99.99% uptime SLA

Flat monthly rate. No per-minute charges. No overage fees. Call volume does not affect the price. Setup fee waived on annual billing. Ongoing support included on all plans.

## Integrations

Native integrations with:
- Housecall Pro (field service management)
- ServiceTitan (enterprise field service)
- Jobber (small/mid business field service)
- FieldEdge (HVAC/plumbing dispatch)
- Workiz (field service and invoicing)
- Google Calendar (scheduling)
- Calendly (appointment booking)
- Zapier (connects to 5,000+ apps)
- Custom API and webhook integrations for any other platform

## How it works

1. Inbound call answered in under 2 seconds
2. AI qualifies the caller — service address, job type, urgency
3. Emergency calls route immediately to on-call tech via SMS before the call ends
4. Non-urgent jobs booked directly into scheduling software
5. Customer receives SMS confirmation
6. Morning summary of all overnight calls delivered to owner

## Setup

Live within 48 hours of onboarding. Includes a 30-minute onboarding call to capture services, pricing, service area, and emergency routing protocols. Phone number porting handled by Calling Matrix — customers see no change. Ongoing support included — update services, voice, or features at any time after go-live.

## Key differentiators vs. competitors

- **vs. Rosie AI, Goodcall, Dialzara, NextPhone, Allo**: Industry-specific training for home service trades vs. generic AI agents; native field-service CRM integrations; emergency routing built-in; fully managed service
- **vs. Smith.ai, AnswerForce, Ruby (live answering)**: Answers in under 2 seconds vs. 30–90 second agent pickup; flat rate vs. per-minute billing ($1–2/min); unlimited surge capacity vs. agent-pool limits; direct CRM booking vs. message relay
- **vs. voicemail**: Every call answered live; emergency routing immediate vs. callback next morning

## Managed service

Calling Matrix is not a self-serve tool. Every setup is done-for-you:
- We build the AI receptionist trained on your specific business
- We handle number porting and CRM integration
- We manage and maintain the system after go-live
- Ongoing support included — request changes to services, voice, or features anytime

## Social proof

- 37% more booked jobs reported by clients in first 90 days
- $48,000 recovered in missed call revenue (case study: Rick Delgado, HVAC contractor)
- Zero missed calls in 90 days (case study: Jason Pham, 4-truck plumbing shop, Sacramento)
- 94% of callers say it felt like a real person
